newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VILNIAUS TO EXTEND THOMSON RATING AGREEMENT.
newsitem.headline: VILNIAUS TO EXTEND THOMSON RATING AGREEMENT.

text.p: Lithuania's Vilniaus Bank said on Monday it will extend its credit rating agreement with Thomson BankWatch next month.
"We will sign a new agreement with Thomson BankWatch in August," the chairman of the bank, Julius Niedvaras, told a news conference.
Thomson upgraded Vilniaus Bank in June, assiging it a BB long-term senior debt rating, an LC-1 short-term rating for its local currency debt and an IC-B issuer rating.
"If the bank feels that it will need long term credits it might decide on another credit rating in September," Niedvaras added.
He also said that the bank had received offers to carry out the credit ratings from Standard & Poor's, Moody's and IBCA.
